name: cookie-consent-dismisser
description: Chrome extension that automatically accepts or rejects cookie-consent banners on every site.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run icons && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run validate
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../cookie-consent-dismisser.zip . && cd .. && echo 'wrote cookie-consent-dismisser.zip'
